title: 16.07: with -P 0 the client zones in and transfers with no package download, and the patch and revision switches act live
notes: The client starts with -P 0 from a run folder whose PatchConfig.xml points at a live local listener, and a second listener holds 12500, as in patch-off.json; neither may see a connection.

Patch.Enabled is turned on with .settings on the running game server before the wizard enters Ravenwood as in enter-world.json, with the game server's packet log kept to the package download messages, and none is sent. MSG_LOGINCOMPLETE is kept too, to show the filtered packet log writes.
Patch.Enabled is then turned off with .settings on the running game server, and a .tele zone transfer to the Commons sends none either.
Login.AllowedRevision names a revision no client has, so the first login, with Login.EnforceRevision off, is let in; the setting is then turned on with .settings on the running login server,
and the next login after a client restart is refused for its revision without restarting the login server.
Both switches are changed with .settings rather than given on the command line, since a command-line override holds a setting against any live change.
